# Alw Agency

> Web development and digital solutions for small and medium businesses worldwide. We turn business ideas into professional digital products — fast, affordable, built to convert. Based in Wonosobo, Indonesia, serving clients globally.

## Services
- **Company Profile Website** — Professional home base that builds instant trust. Modern design, fast loading, mobile-first.
- **E-Commerce & Online Store** — Full-featured online stores with product management, payment integration, and analytics.
- **Internal Business Systems** — Custom web apps for teams: data management, approvals, HR tools, inventory. Software built around your workflow.
- **Landing Page & Funnel** — High-converting pages for products, campaigns, or events, optimized for one clear goal: leads.
- **SaaS MVP** — Turn a product idea into a working first version quickly.

## Tech stack
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS, Vercel, Stripe, Figma.

## Pricing
- **Launch** — $499 starting point. A focused website build for a clear brief, a tight scope, and a fast route to launch.
- **Growth** — $1,200 starting point (most popular). A deeper build for teams that need a distinctive digital presence and room to grow.
- **Scale** — Custom, scoped project. For custom apps, MVPs, integrations, and products that need thoughtful engineering over time.

## How we work
Discovery & Brief → Design & Prototype → Development → Launch & Support. Most company profile websites take 1–2 weeks; e-commerce projects typically take 3–5 weeks; custom business systems vary based on complexity.
